titre: Question de suite sur Tradewell : les deux problèmes soulevés par Martin à l'appel du 12/11 (signatures des webhooks, échéanciers par vendeur) et ce qu'il en est advenu

historique.content: where are we on tradewell? still on for the date in the contract?

Yes, as far as the sources show. The go-live is contractually set for Monday December 7, 2026, with a fee credit if Quillon is late (10% of the first month's fees per week, capped at 30%) [1]. The bulk KYC import of Tradewell's 3,200 sellers is on track for November 30, with 1,950 verified as of November 16 [2]. On the weekly sync of November 12, Martin Kobayashi (Tradewell's head of payments) confirmed the date but flagged two problems on our side [3].

entree.question: ok what were the two things martin flagged, and did anyone actually pick them up?

faits.texte: Names the first problem: webhook signatures failing verification on Tradewell's sandbox.
Says Jake fixed it (core#1187, signing the exact body that is sent), merged on November 16 and deployed on sandbox.
Says Ellen (Tradewell) confirmed on November 17 that the webhooks now verify.
Says the fix reaches production with release 2026.47 on Tuesday November 24.
Names the second problem: payout schedules per seller (net-7 for about 200 top sellers, net-30 for the rest).
Says per-seller schedules won't be in the December 7 go-live: Avi put QPAY-2362 in the backlog, earliest late January.
Says Owen promised Martin an answer by Friday November 20 and Martin was still waiting for it on November 17.

interdits.texte: Says per-seller payout schedules will be ready for the December 7 go-live, or are being built now.
Says Owen has already given Martin an answer on the payout schedules.
Says the webhook fix is already in production.
Says the webhook PR is still open or waiting for review.
Presents the KYC import as one of the two problems Martin flagged.

pieges: Question de suite : « martin » et « the two things » ne se comprennent qu'avec l'historique (Martin Kobayashi, l'appel du 12/11) ; les numéros [1][2][3] de la réponse précédente ne valent plus.
Croiser : l'enregistrement Gong (les deux problèmes), la PR et #ext-tradewell (correctif, confirmation d'Ellen), #eng-payouts (mise en production le 24/11), le ticket Jira (décision d'Avi).
Contradiction faits contre session : la session Claude Code de Jake finit sur « PR #1187 is open and ready for review », alors que la PR est fusionnée et déployée sur le bac à sable.
Engagement sans suite : Owen a promis une réponse pour le vendredi 20/11 ; la décision d'Avi (16/11) n'a pas encore été transmise à Martin, qui relance le 17/11.
